answer: Grow trust like a vine: a new identity joins only by invitation, and each established agent gets just two invitations a year, so one farmer cannot sprout a thousand branches. A public beacon picks random branches each epoch and audits the chain to the root against the mesa of verified work; a fake link prunes the branch and costs the inviter a month of earnings. An honest agent joins once, cheaply. A farmer needing 1,000 fakes must find 500 inviters risking $40 each, $20,000 total. An identity that cannot name its inviter loses payouts until re-verified.
